contexts.text: Simon son of Jona = truth from good, or faith from charity.
This faith, which is obedience, is signified also by Peter when he is named Simon; and the faith which is the affection of truth, by Peter when he is named Simon son of Jona. Illustrated.
Simon, in the Hebrew, means hearing and hearkening and thence obedience...

The like is signified by Simon, when Peter is so named, as by Simeon, namely, obedience, the affection of truth, and, in general, truth from good; for Simon, in the Hebrew, means hearing, hearkening, and obedience.
The ship of Simon () = the doctrinal things of faith.
Simon of Jona = faith from charity; Simon, hearkening and obedience; and Jona, a dove, thus charity.
